Integrations/Marketing

Zoho Campaigns

Manage Zoho Campaigns mailing lists, contacts, campaigns, reports, topics, tags, custom fields, and segments through the management API.

38 actionsSign in with Zoho Campaigns

Connect Zoho Campaigns

What your bot can do in Zoho Campaigns

Looks up

  • Count Mailing List ContactsCount contacts in a mailing list for one subscription, bounce, or spam status.
  • Get Campaign DetailsGet a campaign's status, sender, recipients, reach, and summary report data.
  • Get Campaign ReportGet aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, and reach metrics for one campaign.
  • Get Coupon DetailsGet a coupon's code, recipient, campaign, sent and expiry dates, and current status.
  • Get Last Campaign ReportGet aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, and reach metrics for the organization's most recently sent campaign.
  • Get Mailing List DetailsGet a mailing list's contact statistics, client and device breakdowns, and optionally filtered campaign details one page at a time.
  • Get Segment DetailsGet the filtering criteria and metadata for a segment in a mailing list.
  • List Campaign RecipientsList recipients in one campaign delivery or engagement state, one page at a time.
  • List Contact FieldsList standard and custom contact fields available to the connected Campaigns organization.
  • List Mailing List ContactsList contacts in a mailing list, optionally filtered by subscription or bounce status, one page at a time.
Show 8 more
  • List Mailing ListsList mailing lists and their contact, ownership, segment, and status metadata one page at a time.
  • List Open WorkflowsList open custom workflows one page at a time.
  • List Recent CampaignsList recent campaigns filtered by lifecycle status, one page at a time.
  • List Recently Sent CampaignsReturn up to a requested number of the most recently sent campaigns.
  • List Segment ContactsList contacts belonging to a Zoho Campaigns segment one page at a time.
  • List TagsList all Zoho Campaigns contact tags and their metadata.
  • List Topic ProductsList products available for brand-product topics one page at a time.
  • List TopicsList subscription topics for the organization one page at a time.

Takes action

  • Add Contacts to Mailing ListAdd between one and ten email addresses to an existing Zoho Campaigns mailing list in one request.
  • Add Mailing List and ContactsCreate a Zoho Campaigns mailing list and optionally add up to ten email addresses in the same call.
  • Associate Tag with ContactAssociate an existing Zoho Campaigns contact tag with one contact email address.
  • Clone CampaignClone an existing campaign into a new draft with a new name and subject.
  • Create CampaignCreate an email campaign draft for mailing-list or segment recipients.
  • Create Contact FieldCreate a custom contact field in Zoho Campaigns.
  • Create TagCreate a Zoho Campaigns contact tag with a description and color.
  • Create TopicCreate a brand topic or brand-product topic.
  • Delete CampaignPermanently delete one Zoho Campaigns campaign by exact campaign key.
  • Delete Mailing ListPermanently delete a mailing list.
Show 10 more
  • Delete TagPermanently delete one Zoho Campaigns contact tag by exact name.
  • Dissociate Tag from ContactRemove an existing Zoho Campaigns contact-tag association without deleting the tag or contact.
  • Mark Coupon UsedIrreversibly mark a Zoho Campaigns coupon as used.
  • Move Contact to Do-Not-MailPermanently suppress one email address across the connected Zoho Campaigns organization by moving it to the Do-Not-Mail registry.
  • Schedule CampaignSchedule a reviewed campaign for future delivery.
  • Send CampaignImmediately and irreversibly send a reviewed Zoho Campaigns campaign to its entire configured audience.
  • Subscribe ContactAdd or update one contact in a mailing list.
  • Trigger Workflow ContactsAdd between one and 200 contacts to a Zoho Campaigns custom workflow.
  • Unsubscribe ContactUnsubscribe one contact from a mailing list or topic.
  • Update Mailing ListRename a mailing list and set its signup form visibility.
